metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Verona by morning light, a meal under the notch, the same page at night, and a minute about the ticket.

yesterday: On the Verona page the month is struck and the days are still a blank.
You boarded once, at threepence. The loaf was short of the notch, and she told you to eat.
The ticket is a hundred shillings, called near. It stayed in the sleeve.
Field has not brought the chronicle.
